app.name: SitePilot
app.tagline: Describe your website. AI runs it.
app.description: SitePilot is an AI website operating system: it researches, writes, publishes and maintains your website on autopilot.

hero.title: Describe your website. AI runs it.
hero.subtitle: SitePilot turns a plain-language brief into a blueprint, a full site and a steady publishing rhythm — then keeps researching, writing, optimizing and maintaining it.

features.title: Not a website builder. An operator.
features.subtitle: Everything needed to launch and run a site for months, not minutes.
features.f1Desc: Describe the site in plain language. The AI returns a structured blueprint you can review and edit before anything is generated.
features.f2Desc: Pick a rhythm — three posts a week or daily. The scheduler creates tasks, the agents research, write, edit and publish.
features.f3Desc: Research, writer, editor, SEO, analytics and publisher agents each have explicit, limited tool permissions.
features.f4Desc: SEO audits, metadata fixes, content refreshes and internal linking run in the background.
features.f5Desc: Every AI run is logged with agent, model, duration and token usage — nothing happens in the dark.
features.f6Desc: Run the whole platform from a phone: drawers instead of sidebars, cards instead of tables.

steps.title: How it works
steps.s1Desc: Tell SitePilot what the site is about, who it is for and how often it should publish.
steps.s2Desc: Review categories, pages, content types, tone and SEO strategy. Edit anything.
steps.s3Desc: Pages, categories, SEO metadata and the first articles are created and previewed.
steps.s4Desc: Manual, review-before-publishing or full autopilot — you choose how much control to give.

cta.cta: Start now — it's free in development
